conclusions.conclusion: The requested source commit is the local baseline and the working branch name matches the contract.
q_actual, q_plan_target, q_plan_trajectory and q_hardware_command are represented separately; slider changes do not submit hardware commands.

The router validates active_joint_mask, activation_epoch, command lease, exact trajectory descriptors and fresh non-replayable execute proofs. It independently consumes gravity status and can inject a session-bound gravity authority immediately before UDP dispatch; the frozen continuous-load authority is false, so the current path intentionally rejects real POSITION.

GO requires endpoint residence inside the 0.5 degree window for at least 0.5 s and at least 50 valid frames, revokes arrival after drift, and latches domain BRAKE if stable arrival is absent at 90 s. Exact v1.3 trajectories entering the >=55 C protection region abort to a thermal latch and require re-preview; only legacy profiles and HOLD retain live derating.

J6 exact v1.3 trajectories entering the >=55 C protection region latch and verify DISABLED without independently scaling signed q/dq samples; release, cooldown, a higher activation epoch, next-cycle rearm and a fresh preview are required. Legacy POS_VEL profiles and HOLD retain live 55-60 C derating.

GO and J6 validate thermal_limits.yaml SHA256 1926264805858f62fffc9360ef0c9d4d7f8a7e232e171105450769d493ff5467 before opening hardware. GO publishes per-motor thermal_state_by_motor while retaining the top-level domain thermal_state. No powered thermal data were collected.

Immediate GO domain-BRAKE transactions commit their returned mode and telemetry into the same state snapshot. An unconfirmed response is represented per motor as controller mode unknown with brake_observed=false; commanded intent is not reported as observed BRAKE.

The gravity-node to Router to GO software feedforward chain is connected and independently guarded, but the frozen gravity configuration deliberately declares continuous_rotor_limits_authoritative=false. With no powered current-session MODEL_SESSION_ANCHOR_V2 or direction/load evidence, Router rejects authority and Tff remains zero.

Planned and actual twins own independent MjData objects. Each renderer uses one dedicated background thread with latest-frame coalescing, and both renderer contexts are closed through their owning worker threads.
J1-J6 position, multi-joint, thermal endurance and final BRAKE/DISABLED acceptance were not run because the robot arm is powered off.
